Monica (People Ops): @here Quick update — we’re launching a 6-month pilot for two People Ops policy changes effective May 1.
• Parental Leave Top-up (pilot): Redwood will top up base statutory pay for eligible parents up to 12 weeks (region-specific amounts). Pilot countries: US, UK, CA. Applies to biological, adoptive, and surrogate parents. Details and signup: https://redwood.internal/hr/par-topup (please read eligibility section).
• Comp-time accrual: instead of PTO for short off-cycle work (on-call, major cross-time-zone launches), you can now elect "comp-time". Key points: accrual cap = 40 hours, must be used within 6 months of accrual, manager approval required for use, and it cannot be cashed out except at termination per local law.

hr-bot: Policy doc updated: https://redwood.internal/hr/policies/comp-time-par-topup — version 2026-05-01

Raj Patel: Quick Q — am I eligible if I'm 60% time (reduced schedule)?

Monica (People Ops): Yes — eligibility is pro-rated for part-time employees. The doc has the exact prorate table under "Eligibility". If you're unsure ping me and I'll check for you.

Lisa Nguyen: Does comp-time affect carryover of annual PTO? Trying to plan Q3.

Monica (People Ops): Comp-time is separate from your annual PTO bucket. It does not change PTO carryover rules. You use comp-time alongside PTO but approval still goes through your manager.

Carlos Ortega: How do we request comp-time? Is there a form or calendar block?

Monica (People Ops): Use the HR portal or the Slack shortcut. Example request (HR portal "Request Comp-time"):
```
/comp-time request --hours 4 --date 2026-05-12 --reason "overnight incident support" --manager @sarah
```
HR will auto-notify manager for approval. After approval, it's added to your comp-time balance.

Emma Li: Is the parental top-up available for adoption finalization leave? I’ll be adopting later this year.

Monica (People Ops): Yes — adoption finalization and placement are covered. The top-up applies to the primary caregiver leave period. See the "Covered Events" list in the policy.

Raj Patel: Will this be retroactive to leaves starting April? I had a leave start Apr 20.

Monica (People Ops): The pilot starts May 1 and is not retroactive. If you started Apr 20 we can discuss case-by-case — message me privately and I'll escalate.

Lisa Nguyen: Any reporting/metrics we should expect? Will pilot extend if uptake is low?

Monica (People Ops): We’ll track uptake, regional utilization, and manager feedback. Pilot review scheduled Nov 1. If metrics look good we’ll propose permanent policy.

Carlos Ortega: :thumbsup: thanks — that CLI example helps.

Monica (People Ops): Office hours tomorrow 9–10am PT in #people-ops-office-hours for questions. Thanks team! :heart:
